verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for payments platforms, since some payment and orchestration products offer self-deployable versions, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Checkout.com as a vendor-operated platform ("we'll handle physical cards", "We can manage decisions for you"). Nothing shows a self-hostable deployment, source release, or on-prem option.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
